title: pidfd_send_signal rejects the /proc/PID directory-FD form
mechanism: get_target_from_pidfd resolves an ordinary FD only by downcasting it to PidFile and returns EBADF otherwise, with a FIXME noting that Linux also accepts an FD from opening /proc/PID.
contract: pidfd_send_signal(2): pidfd may be obtained by opening a /proc/pid directory, by pidfd_open, or through CLONE_PIDFD, and signal 0 to such an FD succeeds.
observed: By source reading at the pin (not run): pidfd_send_signal on an FD from open("/proc/self", O_DIRECTORY) fails with EBADF.

repro.how_to_run: Run `make static` in repro/ on x86-64 Linux, copy bin/abi_probe into an Asterinas guest, and run `abi_probe <case>` for pidfd_procdir. repro/README.md gives the saved Linux output.

caveats: SOURCE LEAD, Asterinas NOT_RUN. Limited to this syscall, not a claim that a /proc/PID FD must work for every pidfd operation. Needs /proc/self to open as a directory in the guest.
